mechanics.claim: Jarvan IV leaps unstoppably to the target champion's location and deals damage to nearby enemies upon arrival, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: leaps with displacement immunity to the target enemy champion's location over 0.35 seconds, dealing physical damage to all nearby enemies upon arrival.

mechanics.claim: The ability's cooldown does not start until after the effect resolves.
The initial cast and manual recast both count as ability activations for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: The initial cast and the manual recast count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as Spellblade and triggering Force Pulse Kassadin passive.

mechanics.claim: Spell Shield blocks the impact damage but not the terrain generation.
mechanics.quote: Spell shield will block the damage but not the terrain generation.

mechanics.claim: If Jarvan IV is killed while leaping, Cataclysm deals no damage, generates no terrain, and does not refund its cooldown.
mechanics.quote: Cataclysm will not deal damage, generate terrain, nor refund its cooldown if Jarvan IV is killed while leaping.
